_comment: Three-layer idle bow: limb on top of riser on top of string. Layer order matters — generated parents draw layer0 first, so the limb winds up in front like in the original modular_loader output. Material variation (per-BowAssembly limb/riser/string materials) will come back once we register a fletcherstrestle:modular_bow ItemModel type that reads the component; for now this is the default oak+wood+flax look.
